notes.expected_text: case-insensitive substrings that must appear in the app's answer; an item written 'A|B' is satisfied by either A or B (synonyms given in the gold, e.g. CIP199062.1|Dagga)

notes.sign: reductions are asked as positive percentages ('by what percent lower'); signed quantities (correlations, heterosis, differences in percentage points) keep their sign
notes.alternatives: list of {expected, expected_text, note}; accepted alternative values/texts from grading_notes (or the item's verification notes / gold answer, as the note says)
notes.checkable: false = the key fact is a published paper value or an approximate/prose statement the app cannot be graded on from SPB data; the sub-question is kept for completeness
